target: Windows XP SP3, default blue Luna, normal font size, 96 DPI
referenceDpi: Inferred from unscaled 30 px taskbar and 21 px caption controls; not metadata-certified
rights: Public original-system screenshots are analysis references only. No screenshot, Microsoft wallpaper, logo, font, icon pack or msstyles binary is shipped. Polly glyphs and all painter code are original project work.

comparison.titleStrip: Native painter-only 2x30 PPM column 0 is the fixed-source old title; column 1 is the new helper. Compare with notepad x=300, y=0..29 without resampling.
comparison.imageDifference: Mean absolute RGB channel difference, maximum absolute channel difference and changed pixel count; report numbers, not an invented pass threshold.
comparison.exclusions: The one-pixel title/taskbar strips intentionally contain no text, icons or antialiasing. Full component crops must include all pixels; font and glyph differences are not masked. No full-desktop score until native screenshots exist.
